subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live WSL2/Docker reproduction before queueing a fix for selected-agent heartbeats under `session.scope: "global"`, or is the source-backed path enough to start repair now?
rationale: The source path strongly matches the reporter’s latest evidence, but changing global-session heartbeat storage/routing may affect existing global-scope users and should be anchored by live proof.

options.title: Live repro first, then fix
options.body: Reproduce the reporter’s global-scope configuration in WSL2 or Docker, then queue a focused fix against the confirmed session/store boundary.

options.title: Queue source-backed repair now
options.body: Start a repair PR from the source evidence and require the PR to add regression coverage plus live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep paused for owner design
options.body: Treat selected-agent global sessions as a compatibility design question and wait for an owner to define the permanent storage/routing contract.

recommendation.title: Live repro first, then fix
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reporter’s global-scope configuration in WSL2 or Docker, then queue a focused fix against the confirmed session/store boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame points to recent work on the exact heartbeat/session routing block, though the shallow history limits confidence.
